title: Owner: try the skill on the real fleet and promote or refuse it
goal: The owner sees the checklist for Saturday and decides whether the skill is promoted
acceptance: Owner decision 2026-11-26 in chat: "y" to the skills panel and pre-flight skill plan (earlier: "pre flight check, ok", real data).

After fpvbuddy:F-024-T05 (the real fleet is imported and fpv_preflight checked) and F-145-T02 (the panel shows the skill), the owner follows a copy-paste page (docs/acceptance/f146-preflight-skill-<date>.md, written by the agent): (1) `nerv skills list` shows preflight-volo staged; (2) the dashboard panel Kaji's watermelons shows it under Sprout with its evaluation; (3) ask NERV "prepara il volo di sabato" and read the checklist against the real batteries, drones and the weather; (4) ask "prepare Saturday's flight" and check the answer is in English; (5) `nerv skills promote preflight-volo <version>` only if the owner is satisfied (the promote is the owner's), else `nerv skills retire`
The owner's decision and any wrong line (a B- record for a wrong verdict) are recorded in F-146
privacy: The owner's real data stays on their machine; the acceptance page holds invented examples only.
validation: Owner check, recorded in F-146 Verification
escalation: A material scope or effort increase goes to the owner
A visible change in how a section looks or behaves goes to the owner

effort.basis: Estimated 2026-11-26: one short procedure on the live service. Not a measurement.
